graph_hash_method: sha256 of json.dumps({'components': {name: sorted(globs)}, 'edges': [sorted by name]}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')). Components are read with component_coupling.parse_component_map -- the same parser goals_freeze_gate uses, not a second reader of the same block, so this marker and that gate cannot disagree about what a component is. Interfaces are read with an equivalent narrow regex over the ```yaml interfaces block, because no parser for that block exists anywhere in bollard; it is declared for humans and for this marker, and no gate reads it today. Recomputable by rerunning the derivation against ARCHITECTURE.md.
status: Record of intent, not an enforced re-entry boundary. foreman:validate states the fuller freeze/re-qualification gate this marker feeds is not wired live in this build, so nothing currently reads this file or denies on a graph_hash mismatch. Written so that when such a gate is wired, there is a real prior graph to compare against rather than a first observation being treated as a baseline.
